name: Poyo Yo! Demon
source:
Yuu holds no love for demons. Because of them, Yuu has always had to crossdress to hide her identity. When she joins GateLight Corp, a supposedly ordinary, renewable energy company, she never thought she would end up having to confront them.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20158]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
优对恶魔没有好感。因为他们，Yuu总是不得不变装来隐藏自己的身份。当她加入GateLight Corp（一家被认为是普通的可再生能源公司）时，她从未想过自己最终会不得不面对他们。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20158]引理软论坛[/url]]
